metadata.description: Personal agentic workflow skills developed for use with my work projects

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design-phase skills: deep-dive a plan to shared understanding a round of questions at a time, maintain the project's domain model with a CONTEXT.md glossary and MADR-minimal ADRs, and build throwaway prototypes that answer questions reasoning can't.

plugins.name: enotime
plugins.description: ENOTIME draws an Oblique Strategy on demand in Codex or Claude Code, and automatically at Claude Code session start.

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Session relay: handoff writes a self-contained document any agent can pick up; pickup verifies and resumes it. Trivia-aware, with a plain-file fallback.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Skills for holistic and change-set Rust review, language-neutral application security, and Rust-specific security.

plugins.name: trivium
plugins.description: Project-memory workflow on the trivia MCP: bootstrap, session start + retro, periodic memory gardening, and cross-source cited research.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Skills for writing prose, commits, code comments, design docs, and agent documents clearly and concisely, without bafflegab and with the necessary information.
